description.zh-CN: 暗金侦探圆桌推理博弈，支持 4/6 人自由组局、近义词题库与发言指认。
description.zh-TW: 暗金偵探圓桌推理博弈，支援 4/6 人自由組局、近義詞題庫與發言指認。
description.en: Noir detective social deduction game supporting 4 or 6 players, curated word pairs, clues, and voting.
description.ja: 4人または6人対応のノワール探偵ソーシャル推理ゲーム。厳選されたワードペア、ヒント、投票を備えています。
description.ko: 4명 또는 6명을 지원하는 누아르 탐정 소셜 추리 게임으로, 엄선된 단어 쌍, 단서, 투표를 제공합니다.
description.es: Juego de deducción social de detectives noir para 4 o 6 jugadores, con parejas de palabras seleccionadas, pistas y votación.
description.de: Noir-Detektivspiel mit sozialer Deduktion für 4 oder 6 Spieler, kuratierte Wortpaare, Hinweise und Abstimmungen.
description.fr: Jeu de déduction sociale de détective noir pour 4 ou 6 joueurs, avec paires de mots sélectionnées, indices et votes.

  return count === 4 ? allSeats.slice(0, 4) : allSeats.slice(0, 6);

/**
 * Returns the curated word bank corresponding to the given locale (default: zh-CN).
 */
function wordLocale(raw?: string): "en" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | keyof typeof translatedWords {
 const lang = (raw || "en").toLowerCase();
 if (/^zh-(tw|hk|mo|hant)(-|$)/.test(lang)) return "zh-TW";
 if (lang === "zh" || lang.startsWith("zh-")) return "zh-CN";
 const base = lang.split("-")[0];
 return base === "ja" || base === "ko" || base === "es" || base === "de" || base === "fr" ? base : "en";
}
export function getWordPairsForLocale(locale?: string): WordPair[] {
 const lang = wordLocale(locale);
 if (lang === "en") return WORD_PAIRS_EN;
 if (lang === "zh-TW") return WORD_PAIRS_ZHTW;
 if (lang === "zh-CN") return WORD_PAIRS;
 return translatedWords[lang] as WordPair[];
}

/**
 * Helper to select a word pair respecting the current locale.
 */
export function selectWordPair(
  category: WordCategory,
  roundSeed: number,
  customCivilian?: string | null,
  customUndercover?: string | null,
  locale?: string,
): WordPair {
  const loc = wordLocale(locale);
  const isEn = loc === "en";
  const isTw = loc === "zh-TW";

  if (
    category === "custom" &&
    customCivilian &&
    customCivilian.trim() &&
    customUndercover &&
    customUndercover.trim()
  ) {
    const civ = customCivilian.trim();
    const und = customUndercover.trim();

    const civilianClues = isEn
      ? [
          `An everyday concept familiar to all of us, consisting of ${civ.length} characters.`,
          "A tangible and distinct mental picture comes to mind when you picture it.",
          "Very recognizable within its category, often encountered in daily conversations.",
          "Its core attributes are prominent, with subtle nuances compared to related terms.",
          "Listening to prior clues, my description leans toward the mainstream scenario.",
        ]
      : isTw
      ? [
          `日常生活中大家都很熟悉的事物，一共 ${civ.length} 個字`,
          "提到它的時候，大家腦海裡會有很具體的畫面感",
          "在同類東西裡辨識度很高，平時經常會接觸或聊到",
          "它的核心特點很鮮明，但細節上跟相近概念略有區別",
          "注意聽前幾位描述的使用場景，我這個更偏向主流常見款",
        ]
      : [
          `日常生活中大家都很熟悉的事物，一共 ${civ.length} 个字`,
          "提到它的时候，大家脑海里会有很具体的画面感",
          "在同类东西里辨识度很高，平时经常会接触或聊到",
          "它的核心特点很鲜明，但细节上跟相近概念略有区别",
          "注意听前几位描述的使用场景，我这个更偏向主流常见款",
        ];

    const undercoverClues = isEn
      ? [
          `A widely recognized concept we frequently encounter, spelled with ${und.length} characters.`,
          "Tied closely to life experiences with its own unique use cases.",
          "Its functionality is prominent and indispensable in specific scenarios.",
          "Hearing everyone's clues, the broad direction aligns, but details feel intriguing.",
          "My concept has distinct features; I will share subtle clues to test the waters.",
        ]
      : isTw
      ? [
          `平時經常能聽到或見到的概念，字數是 ${und.length} 個字`,
          "和生活體驗息息相關，有自己獨特的使用場景",
          "功能屬性很明確，在特定場合下幾乎不可或缺",
          "聽大家的描述感覺大方向很接近，但側重點似乎有一點微妙差異",
          "我手裡的這份特徵很典型，先穩一手看看風向",
        ]
      : [
          `平时经常能听到或见到的概念，字数是 ${und.length} 个字`,
          "和生活体验息息相关，有自己独特的使用场景",
          "功能属性很明确，在特定场合下几乎不可或缺",
          "听大家的描述感觉大方向很接近，但侧重点似乎有一点微妙差异",
          "我手里的这个特征很典型，先稳一手看看风向",
        ];

    return {
      id: `custom-${roundSeed}${["ja", "ko", "es", "de", "fr"].includes(loc) ? "-" + loc : ""}`,
      category: "daily",
      civilianWord: civ,
      undercoverWord: und,
      civilianClues: loc === "en" || loc === "zh-CN" || loc === "zh-TW" ? civilianClues : extra[loc].customClues.slice(0, 5).map(clue => clue.replace(/\{count\}/g, String(civ.length))),
      undercoverClues: loc === "en" || loc === "zh-CN" || loc === "zh-TW" ? undercoverClues : extra[loc].customClues.slice(5).map(clue => clue.replace(/\{count\}/g, String(und.length))),
    };
  }

  const baseList = getWordPairsForLocale(locale);
  const pool =
    category === "all" || category === "custom"
      ? baseList
      : baseList.filter((w) => w.category === category);

  const list = pool.length > 0 ? pool : baseList;
  const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length);
  const chosen = list[idx] || list[0];

  // Randomly swap civilian and undercover 50% of the time so even familiar pairs stay fresh!
  if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
    return {
      id: `${chosen.id}-swap`,
      category: chosen.category,
      civilianWord: chosen.undercoverWord,
      undercoverWord: chosen.civilianWord,
      civilianClues: chosen.undercoverClues,
      undercoverClues: chosen.civilianClues,
    };
  }
  return chosen;
}

export function createInitialPosition(
  round: number,
  playerCount: 4 | 6 = 4,
  undercoverCount: 1 | 2 = 1,
  category: WordCategory = "all",
  customCiv: string | null = null,
  customUnd: string | null = null,
  fixedUndercoverSeats?: Seat[],
  locale?: string,
): UndercoverPosition {
  const activeSeats = seatsForCount(playerCount);
  const actualUndercoverCount = playerCount === 4 ? 1 : undercoverCount;

  const pair = selectWordPair(category, round, customCiv, customUnd, locale);

  let undercoverSet: Set<Seat>;
  if (fixedUndercoverSeats && fixedUndercoverSeats.length > 0) {
    undercoverSet = new Set(fixedUndercoverSeats);
  } else {
    const shuffled = [...activeSeats];
    for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [shuffled[i], shuffled[j]] = [shuffled[j], shuffled[i]];
    }
    undercoverSet = new Set(shuffled.slice(0, actualUndercoverCount));
  }

  const roles: Record<Seat, PlayerRole> = {
    Seat1: "Civilian",
    Seat2: "Civilian",
    Seat3: "Civilian",
    Seat4: "Civilian",
    Seat5: "Civilian",
    Seat6: "Civilian",
  };
  const words: Record<Seat, string> = {
    Seat1: "",
    Seat2: "",
    Seat3: "",
    Seat4: "",
    Seat5: "",
    Seat6: "",
  };

  for (const s of activeSeats) {
    if (undercoverSet.has(s)) {
      roles[s] = "Undercover";
      words[s] = pair.undercoverWord;
    } else {
      roles[s] = "Civilian";
      words[s] = pair.civilianWord;
    }
  }

  const startOffset = round > 0 ? (round - 1) % activeSeats.length : 0;
  const speakingOrder = [
    ...activeSeats.slice(startOffset),
    ...activeSeats.slice(0, startOffset),
  ];

  const emptyVotes: Record<Seat, { target: Seat; reason: string | null } | null> = {
    Seat1: null,
    Seat2: null,
    Seat3: null,
    Seat4: null,
    Seat5: null,
    Seat6: null,
  };

  const emptyLastActions = {
    Seat1: null,
    Seat2: null,
    Seat3: null,
    Seat4: null,
    Seat5: null,
    Seat6: null,
  };

  return {
    cycle: 1,
    pkRound: 0,
    pkCandidates: [],
    turn: round > 0 ? speakingOrder[0] : null,
    turnStartedAt: round > 0 ? Date.now() : null,
    activeSeats,
    aliveSeats: [...activeSeats],
    speakingOrder,
    spokenSeats: [],
    votingOrder: [...speakingOrder],
    currentVotes: emptyVotes,
    roles,
    words,
    civilianWord: pair.civilianWord,
    undercoverWord: pair.undercoverWord,
    wordPairId: pair.id,
    speeches: [],
    votes: [],
    eliminated: [],
    lastActions: emptyLastActions,
    lastEvent:
      round > 0
        ? {
            step: 0,
            kind: "deal",
            seat: speakingOrder[0],
            target: null,
            role: null,
            winner: null,
          }
        : null,
    stepCount: 0,
    winner: null,
    winReason: null,
  };
}

/**
 * Checks whether the speech illegally contains the player's own secret word verbatim.
 */
export function containsOwnSecretWord(speech: string, secretWord: string): boolean {
  if (!secretWord) return false;
  const normalizedSpeech = speech.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "");
  const normalizedWord = secretWord.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "");
  return normalizedSpeech.includes(normalizedWord);
}

export function eligibleVoteTargetsFor(
  p: UndercoverPosition,
  voter: Seat,
): Seat[] {
  const pool =
    p.pkRound > 0 && p.pkCandidates.length > 0 ? p.pkCandidates : p.aliveSeats;
  const withoutSelf = pool.filter((s) => s !== voter);
  return withoutSelf.length > 0
    ? withoutSelf
    : p.aliveSeats.filter((s) => s !== voter);
}

export function applySpeak(
  l: UndercoverLobby,
  p: UndercoverPosition,
  seat: Seat,
  rawText: string,
): { lobby: UndercoverLobby; position: UndercoverPosition } {
  if (l.phase !== "speaking") {
    throw new Error("The game is not in the speaking phase");
  }
  if (p.turn !== seat) {
    throw new Error(`It is not ${seat}'s turn to speak`);
  }
  const text = rawText.trim();
  if (!text) {
    throw new Error("Your clue must not be empty");
  }
  const myWord = p.words[seat];
  if (containsOwnSecretWord(text, myWord)) {
    throw new Error(
      "Your clue must not include your secret word",
    );
  }

  const nextStep = p.stepCount + 1;
  const nextSpoken = [...p.spokenSeats, seat];
  const nextSpeeches = [
    ...p.speeches,
    {
      step: nextStep,
      cycle: p.cycle,
      isPk: p.pkRound > 0,
      seat,
      text,
    },
  ];
  const nextLastActions = {
    ...p.lastActions,
    [seat]: {
      kind: "speak" as const,
      cycle: p.cycle,
      text,
      target: null,
      reason: null,
    },
  };

  const remainingSpeakers = p.speakingOrder.filter(
    (s) => !nextSpoken.includes(s),
  );

  if (remainingSpeakers.length > 0) {
    const nextTurn = remainingSpeakers[0];
    return {
      lobby: l,
      position: {
        ...p,
        turn: nextTurn,
        turnStartedAt: Date.now(),
        spokenSeats: nextSpoken,
        speeches: nextSpeeches,
        lastActions: nextLastActions,
        lastEvent: {
          step: nextStep,
          kind: "speak",
          seat,
          target: null,
          role: null,
          winner: null,
        },
        stepCount: nextStep,
      },
    };
  }

  const votingOrder = [...p.aliveSeats];
  const resetVotes: Record<Seat, { target: Seat; reason: string | null } | null> = {
    Seat1: null,
    Seat2: null,
    Seat3: null,
    Seat4: null,
    Seat5: null,
    Seat6: null,
  };

  return {
    lobby: {
      ...l,
      phase: "voting",
    },
    position: {
      ...p,
      turn: votingOrder[0],
      turnStartedAt: Date.now(),
      spokenSeats: nextSpoken,
      votingOrder,
      currentVotes: resetVotes,
      speeches: nextSpeeches,
      lastActions: nextLastActions,
      lastEvent: {
        step: nextStep,
        kind: "speak",
        seat,
        target: null,
        role: null,
        winner: null,
      },
      stepCount: nextStep,
    },
  };
}

export function applyVote(
  l: UndercoverLobby,
  p: UndercoverPosition,
  voter: Seat,
  target: Seat,
  rawReason?: string | null,
): { lobby: UndercoverLobby; position: UndercoverPosition } {
  if (l.phase !== "voting") {
    throw new Error("The game is not in the voting phase");
  }
  if (p.turn !== voter) {
    throw new Error(`It is not ${voter}'s turn to vote`);
  }
  if (voter === target) {
    throw new Error("You cannot vote for yourself");
  }
  const allowedTargets = eligibleVoteTargetsFor(p, voter);
  if (!allowedTargets.includes(target)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Target must be one of the eligible seats: ${allowedTargets.join(", ")}`,
    );
  }

  const reason = rawReason?.trim() ? rawReason.trim() : null;
  const nextStep = p.stepCount + 1;
  const nextCurrentVotes = {
    ...p.currentVotes,
    [voter]: { target, reason },
  };
  const nextVotes = [
    ...p.votes,
    {
      step: nextStep,
      cycle: p.cycle,
      isPk: p.pkRound > 0,
      voter,
      target,
      reason,
    },
  ];
  const nextLastActions = {
    ...p.lastActions,
    [voter]: {
      kind: "vote" as const,
      cycle: p.cycle,
      text: null,
      target,
      reason,
    },
  };

  const remainingVoters = p.votingOrder.filter(
    (s) => nextCurrentVotes[s] === null,
  );

  if (remainingVoters.length > 0) {
    const nextTurn = remainingVoters[0];
    return {
      lobby: l,
      position: {
        ...p,
        turn: nextTurn,
        turnStartedAt: Date.now(),
        currentVotes: nextCurrentVotes,
        votes: nextVotes,
        lastActions: nextLastActions,
        lastEvent: {
          step: nextStep,
          kind: "vote",
          seat: voter,
          target,
          role: null,
          winner: null,
        },
        stepCount: nextStep,
      },
    };
  }

  const tally: Record<Seat, number> = {
    Seat1: 0,
    Seat2: 0,
    Seat3: 0,
    Seat4: 0,
    Seat5: 0,
    Seat6: 0,
  };
  for (const s of p.votingOrder) {
    const v = nextCurrentVotes[s];
    if (v) {
      tally[v.target] = (tally[v.target] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  const candidatePool =
    p.pkRound > 0 && p.pkCandidates.length > 0 ? p.pkCandidates : p.aliveSeats;
  let maxVotes = -1;
  for (const c of candidatePool) {
    if (tally[c] > maxVotes) maxVotes = tally[c];
  }
  const topSeats = candidatePool.filter((c) => tally[c] === maxVotes);

  if (topSeats.length > 1 && p.pkRound === 0) {
    return {
      lobby: {
        ...l,
        phase: "speaking",
      },
      position: {
        ...p,
        pkRound: 1,
        pkCandidates: topSeats,
        turn: topSeats[0],
        turnStartedAt: Date.now(),
        speakingOrder: topSeats,
        spokenSeats: [],
        currentVotes: nextCurrentVotes,
        votes: nextVotes,
        lastActions: nextLastActions,
        lastEvent: {
          step: nextStep,
          kind: "pk_tie",
          seat: voter,
          target: topSeats[0],
          role: null,
          winner: null,
        },
        stepCount: nextStep,
      },
    };
  }

  const eliminatedSeat = topSeats[0];
  const eliminatedRole = p.roles[eliminatedSeat];
  const eliminatedWord = p.words[eliminatedSeat];
  const nextAlive = p.aliveSeats.filter((s) => s !== eliminatedSeat);
  const nextEliminated = [
    ...p.eliminated,
    {
      cycle: p.cycle,
      seat: eliminatedSeat,
      role: eliminatedRole,
      word: eliminatedWord,
      voteCount: maxVotes,
    },
  ];

  const aliveUndercovers = nextAlive.filter((s) => p.roles[s] === "Undercover");
  const aliveCivilians = nextAlive.filter((s) => p.roles[s] === "Civilian");

  let winner: PlayerRole | null = null;
  let winReason: string | null = null;

  if (aliveUndercovers.length === 0) {
    winner = "Civilian";
    winReason = "Civilians Win · All Undercovers Exposed";
  } else if (
    aliveUndercovers.length >= aliveCivilians.length ||
    nextAlive.length <= 2
  ) {
    winner = "Undercover";
    winReason = "Undercovers Win · Infiltration Complete";
  }

  if (winner) {
    return {
      lobby: {
        ...l,
        phase: "finished",
      },
      position: {
        ...p,
        pkRound: 0,
        pkCandidates: [],
        turn: null,
        turnStartedAt: null,
        aliveSeats: nextAlive,
        currentVotes: nextCurrentVotes,
        votes: nextVotes,
        eliminated: nextEliminated,
        lastActions: nextLastActions,
        lastEvent: {
          step: nextStep,
          kind: "victory",
          seat: eliminatedSeat,
          target: eliminatedSeat,
          role: eliminatedRole,
          winner,
        },
        stepCount: nextStep,
        winner,
        winReason,
      },
    };
  }

  const nextCycle = p.cycle + 1;
  const shift = (nextCycle - 1) % nextAlive.length;
  const nextSpeakingOrder = [
    ...nextAlive.slice(shift),
    ...nextAlive.slice(0, shift),
  ];

  return {
    lobby: {
      ...l,
      phase: "speaking",
    },
    position: {
      ...p,
      cycle: nextCycle,
      pkRound: 0,
      pkCandidates: [],
      turn: nextSpeakingOrder[0],
      turnStartedAt: Date.now(),
      aliveSeats: nextAlive,
      speakingOrder: nextSpeakingOrder,
      spokenSeats: [],
      votingOrder: [...nextAlive],
      currentVotes: nextCurrentVotes,
      votes: nextVotes,
      eliminated: nextEliminated,
      lastActions: nextLastActions,
      lastEvent: {
        step: nextStep,
        kind: "eliminated",
        seat: eliminatedSeat,
        target: eliminatedSeat,
        role: eliminatedRole,
        winner: null,
      },
      stepCount: nextStep,
    },
  };
}

export function chooseBotSpeech(p: UndercoverPosition, seat: Seat): string {
  const myWord = p.words[seat];
  const baseId = p.wordPairId.replace(/-swap$/, "");
  const allCurated = [...WORD_PAIRS, ...WORD_PAIRS_ZHTW, ...WORD_PAIRS_EN, ...Object.values(translatedWords).flat()];
  const matchedPair =
    allCurated.find(
      (w) =>
        w.id === baseId &&
        (w.civilianWord === myWord || w.undercoverWord === myWord),
    ) || allCurated.find((w) => w.id === baseId);

  let candidateClues: string[] = [];
  if (matchedPair) {
    if (matchedPair.civilianWord === myWord) {
      candidateClues = matchedPair.civilianClues;
    } else if (matchedPair.undercoverWord === myWord) {
      candidateClues = matchedPair.undercoverClues;
    }
  }

  const alreadyUsedTexts = new Set(p.speeches.map((s) => s.text));
  const available = candidateClues.filter(
    (c) => !alreadyUsedTexts.has(c) && !containsOwnSecretWord(c, myWord),
  );

  const translatedLocale = (Object.keys(translatedWords) as Array<keyof typeof translatedWords>).find(locale => baseId.endsWith("-" + locale));
  if (translatedLocale) {
    const dict = auxiliary[translatedLocale];
    const hints = p.pkRound > 0 ? [dict.botDefense0, dict.botDefense1, dict.botDefense2, ...available] : available;
    const fallbacks = [dict.botFallback0, dict.botFallback1, dict.botFallback2, dict.botFallback3, dict.botFallback4].map(clue => clue.replace(/\{count\}/g, String(myWord.length)));
    return [...hints, ...fallbacks].find(clue => !alreadyUsedTexts.has(clue) && !containsOwnSecretWord(clue, myWord)) ?? fallbacks[4];
  }
  const isEnglish = /^[A-Za-z0-9\s\-\.,]+$/.test(myWord);

  if (p.pkRound > 0) {
    if (isEnglish) {
      const pkLinesEn = [
        "Please listen to my previous clue carefully—it aligns with the majority word. I am definitely not the infiltrator!",
        "Do not vote out an innocent teammate! Look closely at the seat whose testimony sounded ambiguous and vague.",
        "Fellow detectives, I kept my clue subtle only to prevent the undercover from guessing the exact word!",
      ];
      for (const line of pkLinesEn) {
        if (!alreadyUsedTexts.has(line) && !containsOwnSecretWord(line, myWord)) {
          return line;
        }
      }
    } else {
      const pkLines = [
        "大家仔细对比我上一轮的描述，我的特征非常贴合主流词，绝对不是卧底！",
        "别投错好人了！我是顺着大家共性属性说的，建议重点盯发言模棱两可的那位。",
        "冤枉啊各位探员，我刚才是怕说太透被卧底猜到词才收敛了一点！",
      ];
      for (const line of pkLines) {
        if (!alreadyUsedTexts.has(line) && !containsOwnSecretWord(line, myWord)) {
          return line;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (available.length > 0) {
    const seatIdx = allSeats.indexOf(seat);
    return available[(p.cycle + seatIdx) % available.length];
  }

  if (isEnglish) {
    const genericFallbacksEn = [
      `A concept very familiar to all of us, consisting of ${myWord.length} letters.`,
      "Encountered very frequently in everyday life; its core attributes match what earlier speakers noted.",
      "My word represents a classic mainstream variant with very clear practical uses.",
      "Listening around the table, someone's emphasis felt off; I will protect my hand without oversharing.",
    ];
    for (const fb of genericFallbacksEn) {
      if (!alreadyUsedTexts.has(fb) && !containsOwnSecretWord(fb, myWord)) {
        return fb;
      }
    }
    return "Its core functionality is universally recognized, and my perspective aligns with the majority.";
  }

  const genericFallbacks = [
    `大家都很熟悉它的日常使用场景，总共是 ${myWord.length} 个字`,
    "在生活里出镜率非常高，特点很鲜明，和前面几位说的属性大体一致",
    "我手里的词偏向大家最常接触的那种款式，细节特征很明显",
    "听完一圈感觉有人的侧重点不太对劲，我先保住底牌不暴露太多",
  ];
  for (const fb of genericFallbacks) {
    if (!alreadyUsedTexts.has(fb) && !containsOwnSecretWord(fb, myWord)) {
      return fb;
    }
  }
  return "它的核心用途大家都很清楚，我跟多数人的方向是一致的。";
}

export function chooseBotVote(
  p: UndercoverPosition,
  voter: Seat,
): { target: Seat; reason: string } {
  const targets = eligibleVoteTargetsFor(p, voter);
  const myRole = p.roles[voter];

  const scored = targets.map((tSeat) => {
    let score = 10;
    const targetRole = p.roles[tSeat];
    if (myRole === "Civilian" && targetRole === "Undercover") {
      score += 12 + p.cycle * 8;
    } else if (myRole === "Undercover" && targetRole === "Civilian") {
      score += 18;
    }
    const hash =
      (allSeats.indexOf(voter) * 7 +
        allSeats.indexOf(tSeat) * 13 +
        p.stepCount) %
      11;
    score += hash;
    return { seat: tSeat, score };
  });

  scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  const chosen = scored[0]?.seat || targets[0];

  const localized = /-(ja|ko|es|de|fr)$/.exec(p.wordPairId.replace(/-swap$/, ""))?.[1];
  if (localized) {
    const label = auxiliary[localized as keyof typeof auxiliary].botVoteReason;
    return { target: chosen, reason: label.replace(/\{target\}/g, chosen) };
  }
  const isEnglish = /^[A-Za-z0-9\s\-\.,]+$/.test(p.words[voter] || "");
  if (isEnglish) {
    const targetNum = chosen.replace("Seat", "");
    const reasonsEn = [
      `Agent #${targetNum}'s clue subtly diverged from consensus; they look most suspicious!`,
      `I feel Agent #${targetNum} was holding back and testing the waters rather than sharing details.`,
      `Comparing earlier clues, Agent #${targetNum}'s description doesn't quite match our concept.`,
      `My intuition suspects Agent #${targetNum} holds a different word—voting to expose them!`,
    ];
    const reason =
      reasonsEn[(p.stepCount + allSeats.indexOf(voter)) % reasonsEn.length];
    return { target: chosen, reason };
  }

  const reasons = [
    `${shortSeatName(chosen)} 的描述方向跟大家有点微妙偏差，嫌疑最大！`,
    `感觉 ${shortSeatName(chosen)} 发言藏着掖着，很像在试探风向。`,
    `对比前后两句线索，${shortSeatName(chosen)} 的细节特征对不上号。`,
    `直觉告诉我 ${shortSeatName(chosen)} 拿的词跟我们不一样，先投一票！`,
  ];
  const reason =
    reasons[(p.stepCount + allSeats.indexOf(voter)) % reasons.length];
  return { target: chosen, reason };
}

export type WidgetLocale = "en" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | "ja" | "ko" | "es" | "de" | "fr";
export function normalizeLocale(raw?: string): WidgetLocale {
  const locale = (raw || "en").toLowerCase();
  if (/^zh-(tw|hk|mo|hant)(-|$)/.test(locale)) return "zh-TW";
  if (locale === "zh" || locale.startsWith("zh-")) return "zh-CN";
  const language = locale.split("-")[0];
  return language === "ja" || language === "ko" || language === "es" || language === "de" || language === "fr" ? language : "en";
}

export function t(key: string, params?: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  const table = dict[currentLocale] || dict.en;
  let raw = table[key] || dict.en[key] || key;
  raw = raw.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (token, key) => params && Object.hasOwn(params, key) ? String(params[key]) : token);
  return raw;
}

export function seatLabel(seat: Seat): string {
  const num = seat.replace("Seat", "");
  if (currentLocale === "zh-CN") return `${num}号探员`;
  if (currentLocale === "zh-TW") return `${num}號探員`;
  const labels = { en: "Agent", ja: "エージェント", ko: "요원", es: "Agente", de: "Agent", fr: "Agent" };
  return `${labels[currentLocale]} #${num}`;
}

export function seatShortLabel(seat: Seat): string {
  const num = seat.replace("Seat", "");
  return currentLocale === "zh-CN" ? `${num}号` : currentLocale === "zh-TW" ? `${num}號` : `#${num}`;
}

export function getLocale(): LocaleKey {
  return currentLocale;
}

export function botNameForSeat(seat: Seat): string {
  const names: Record<"en" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW", Record<Seat, string>> = {
    "zh-CN": {
      Seat1: "探长·福尔摩斯",
      Seat2: "神探·波洛",
      Seat3: "怪盗·基德",
      Seat4: "密探·零号",
      Seat5: "特工·夜莺",
      Seat6: "顾问·莫里亚蒂",
    },
    "zh-TW": {
      Seat1: "探長·福爾摩斯",
      Seat2: "神探·白羅",
      Seat3: "怪盜·基德",
      Seat4: "密探·零號",
      Seat5: "特工·夜鶯",
      Seat6: "顧問·莫里亞蒂",
    },
    en: {
      Seat1: "Insp. Holmes",
      Seat2: "Det. Poirot",
      Seat3: "Phantom Kid",
      Seat4: "Agent Zero",
      Seat5: "Agent Nightingale",
      Seat6: "Prof. Moriarty",
    },
  };
  const table = currentLocale === "en" || currentLocale === "zh-CN" || currentLocale === "zh-TW" ? names[currentLocale] : extra[currentLocale].botNames;
  return table[seat] || names.en[seat] || seatLabel(seat);
}

export function categoryLabel(cat: WordCategory): string {
  if (cat === "tech") return t("catTech");
  if (cat === "food") return t("catFood");
  if (cat === "culture") return t("catCulture");
  if (cat === "daily") return t("catDaily");
  if (cat === "custom") return t("catCustom");
  return t("catAll");
}

export function ui(key: keyof typeof auxiliary.en, params?: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  const value = auxiliary[currentLocale][key] ?? auxiliary.en[key] ?? key;
  return value.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (token, name) => params && Object.hasOwn(params, name) ? String(params[name]) : token);
}

/**
 * Returns the curated word bank corresponding to the given locale (default: zh-CN).
 */
function wordLocale(raw?: string): "en" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | keyof typeof translatedWords {
 const lang = (raw || "en").toLowerCase();
 if (/^zh-(tw|hk|mo|hant)(-|$)/.test(lang)) return "zh-TW";
 if (lang === "zh" || lang.startsWith("zh-")) return "zh-CN";
 const base = lang.split("-")[0];
 return base === "ja" || base === "ko" || base === "es" || base === "de" || base === "fr" ? base : "en";
}
export function getWordPairsForLocale(locale?: string): WordPair[] {
 const lang = wordLocale(locale);
 if (lang === "en") return WORD_PAIRS_EN;
 if (lang === "zh-TW") return WORD_PAIRS_ZHTW;
 if (lang === "zh-CN") return WORD_PAIRS;
 return translatedWords[lang] as WordPair[];
}

/**
 * Helper to select a word pair respecting the current locale.
 */
export function selectWordPair(
  category: WordCategory,
  roundSeed: number,
  customCivilian?: string | null,
  customUndercover?: string | null,
  locale?: string,
): WordPair {
  const loc = wordLocale(locale);
  const isEn = loc === "en";
  const isTw = loc === "zh-TW";

  if (
    category === "custom" &&
    customCivilian &&
    customCivilian.trim() &&
    customUndercover &&
    customUndercover.trim()
  ) {
    const civ = customCivilian.trim();
    const und = customUndercover.trim();

    const civilianClues = isEn
      ? [
          `An everyday concept familiar to all of us, consisting of ${civ.length} characters.`,
          "A tangible and distinct mental picture comes to mind when you picture it.",
          "Very recognizable within its category, often encountered in daily conversations.",
          "Its core attributes are prominent, with subtle nuances compared to related terms.",
          "Listening to prior clues, my description leans toward the mainstream scenario.",
        ]
      : isTw
      ? [
          `日常生活中大家都很熟悉的事物，一共 ${civ.length} 個字`,
          "提到它的時候，大家腦海裡會有很具體的畫面感",
          "在同類東西裡辨識度很高，平時經常會接觸或聊到",
          "它的核心特點很鮮明，但細節上跟相近概念略有區別",
          "注意聽前幾位描述的使用場景，我這個更偏向主流常見款",
        ]
      : [
          `日常生活中大家都很熟悉的事物，一共 ${civ.length} 个字`,
          "提到它的时候，大家脑海里会有很具体的画面感",
          "在同类东西里辨识度很高，平时经常会接触或聊到",
          "它的核心特点很鲜明，但细节上跟相近概念略有区别",
          "注意听前几位描述的使用场景，我这个更偏向主流常见款",
        ];

    const undercoverClues = isEn
      ? [
          `A widely recognized concept we frequently encounter, spelled with ${und.length} characters.`,
          "Tied closely to life experiences with its own unique use cases.",
          "Its functionality is prominent and indispensable in specific scenarios.",
          "Hearing everyone's clues, the broad direction aligns, but details feel intriguing.",
          "My concept has distinct features; I will share subtle clues to test the waters.",
        ]
      : isTw
      ? [
          `平時經常能聽到或見到的概念，字數是 ${und.length} 個字`,
          "和生活體驗息息相關，有自己獨特的使用場景",
          "功能屬性很明確，在特定場合下幾乎不可或缺",
          "聽大家的描述感覺大方向很接近，但側重點似乎有一點微妙差異",
          "我手裡的這份特徵很典型，先穩一手看看風向",
        ]
      : [
          `平时经常能听到或见到的概念，字数是 ${und.length} 个字`,
          "和生活体验息息相关，有自己独特的使用场景",
          "功能属性很明确，在特定场合下几乎不可或缺",
          "听大家的描述感觉大方向很接近，但侧重点似乎有一点微妙差异",
          "我手里的这个特征很典型，先稳一手看看风向",
        ];

    return {
      id: `custom-${roundSeed}${["ja", "ko", "es", "de", "fr"].includes(loc) ? "-" + loc : ""}`,
      category: "daily",
      civilianWord: civ,
      undercoverWord: und,
      civilianClues: loc === "en" || loc === "zh-CN" || loc === "zh-TW" ? civilianClues : extra[loc].customClues.slice(0, 5).map(clue => clue.replace(/\{count\}/g, String(civ.length))),
      undercoverClues: loc === "en" || loc === "zh-CN" || loc === "zh-TW" ? undercoverClues : extra[loc].customClues.slice(5).map(clue => clue.replace(/\{count\}/g, String(und.length))),
    };
  }

  const baseList = getWordPairsForLocale(locale);
  const pool =
    category === "all" || category === "custom"
      ? baseList
      : baseList.filter((w) => w.category === category);

  const list = pool.length > 0 ? pool : baseList;
  const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length);
  const chosen = list[idx] || list[0];

  // Randomly swap civilian and undercover 50% of the time so even familiar pairs stay fresh!
  if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
    return {
      id: `${chosen.id}-swap`,
      category: chosen.category,
      civilianWord: chosen.undercoverWord,
      undercoverWord: chosen.civilianWord,
      civilianClues: chosen.undercoverClues,
      undercoverClues: chosen.civilianClues,
    };
  }
  return chosen;
}
